items.markdown:
Medically proven and FDA-approved treatments like **Minoxidil** and **Finasteride** are the most effective options for hair growth, while many over-the-counter vitamins and botanical serums have limited or no strong clinical backing.[[1]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)[[2]](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/thinning-hair)[[3]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y2wHd-115pc)

### 1. Proven Medical Treatments (What Actually Works)

- **Minoxidil (Rogaine):** Available as an OTC topical liquid, foam, or pill, it works for about two-thirds of users by increasing blood flow to follicles and lengthening the growth phase. It is widely used for androgenetic alopecia (pattern baldness) in both men and women, with the best results seen in those under 40.[[1]](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/thinning-hair)[[2]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)
- **Finasteride (Propecia):** An oral or topical prescription medication for men that lowers DHT (dihydrotestosterone), the hormone responsible for shrinking hair follicles. It stops hair loss in about 90% of men and regrows hair in two-thirds . It is generally unsafe for women of childbearing age but can be prescribed off-label for post-menopausal women.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_UUjAId149o&vl=en-US&t=208)[[2]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)[[3]](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/thinning-hair)
- **Spironolactone or Dutasteride:** Alternative prescription treatments used under a dermatologist's guidance for hormonal or treatment-resistant hair loss.[[1]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_UUjAId149o&vl=en-US&t=208)

### 2. Supplements & Multi-Ingredient Formulas

- **Biotin Megadoses:** As highlighted by [Forbes Vetted](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/) , biotin is heavily marketed, but high doses lack strong scientific backing unless you have a rare medical deficiency.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[2]](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/thinning-hair)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y2wHd-115pc)
- **Targeted Supplements (Nutrafol, Viviscal):** Multi-ingredient nutraceuticals contain marine collagen, ashwagandha, saw palmetto, or vitamins. While some users experience reduced shedding or thicker strands, medical reviews note they work best when addressing underlying stress or mild nutritional gaps rather than genetic pattern baldness. Read more about evidence-backed options via [WebMD](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/thinning-hair).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:13968928883848293800,catalogid:1224001721571416015,gpcid:13820166432832440477&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.amazon.com/Best-Sellers-Hair-Regrowth-Treatments/zgbs/beauty/11057581)[[3]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[4]](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/thinning-hair)

### 3. Topical Oils and Supportive Care

- **Rosemary Oil and Scalp Massage:** Natural options like rosemary oil or regular scalp massage can help stimulate local blood circulation and support scalp health, though results are milder and slower than medical interventions.[[1]](https://www.goodrx.com/well-being/alternative-treatments/natural-hair-growth-products-remedies)
- **Consistency Window:** Most real treatments—whether medical or over-the-counter—require at least 3 to 6 months of continuous daily use before visible regrowth or reduced shedding occurs.[[1]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/hair/best-products-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:13968928883848293800,catalogid:1224001721571416015,gpcid:13820166432832440477&ibp=oshop)
